greet.text: A trader under a red awning by the oasis, flasks and bread and odd bright shards laid out on a cloth. "Nadira. Water by the flask, bread, blades for the Scar road, and books the College won't miss. What'll it be?"

water.text: "For those without a tally-stone. The Sovereign's measure is a season at a time. Not everyone has a season's coin." She shrugs. "I don't make the measure either. I just make it last."
